note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes Layout Paragraphs layout/position data (how paragraphs are arranged into layouts and regions) to the schema. Depends on graphql_compose_layouts. It has no per-bundle config key of its own, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the real, restorable schema-provider registration on the server (schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers.graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs; baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs add to the GraphQL Compose schema?
evals.expected_output: It exposes Layout Paragraphs layout information - which layout each layout-paragraph uses and where child paragraphs sit within its regions - so a decoupled front end can render nested paragraph layouts.

evals.prompt: Which GraphQL Compose helper submodule does graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs depend on, and why?
evals.expected_output: It depends on graphql_compose_layouts for the shared layout definitions/regions (plus core/contrib layout_paragraphs).

evals.prompt: Name the GraphQL types or data producer graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs provides.
evals.expected_output: SchemaTypes LayoutParagraphs, LayoutParagraphsInterface and LayoutParagraphsPosition, plus the LayoutParagraphs DataProducer (wired by LayoutParagraphsSchemaExtension).

evals.prompt: Inspect the GraphQL Compose server configuration (graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server) and state whether graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs is currently registered in the schema providers list.

Register graphql_compose_layout_paragraphs as a GraphQL Compose schema provider on the default server by adding it to schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers on graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
